scene_sentence_zh: 陽光穿過層疊的枝葉，灑在一條蜿蜒的林間小徑上，四周寂靜得只剩下風聲。

license.terms: Original artwork generated for this repository by its maintainers and committed with the project; it may be redistributed under the project's own repository terms. No third-party stock imagery, scraped artwork, or externally licensed asset is included.

production.method: sd-webui txt2img through the repository's internal client (world.art.sd_worker.SDWebUIClient.generate) using the shipped prompt library, then local WebP encoding through world.art.formats.encode
production.description: a layered woodland of tall old trees opening onto a sunlit forest clearing, a winding earthen path strewn with fallen leaves, gnarled roots and mossy stones leading away between the trunks, ferns and leaf litter across an open lower foreground, warm shafts of sunlight slanting through the green canopy into soft atmospheric haze

visual_review.native_scale: Reviewed at native 1536x864: a painterly JRPG layered woodland of tall old trees with a stone-slab forest path receding to a bright sunlit clearing, moss, ferns and fallen leaves across an unobstructed lower foreground, and two small glowing candles as the narrative anchor detail; no interface, watermark or readable lettering, and no town reuse.
visual_review.desktop_cover_crop: Reviewed under the desktop 1451x790 cover crop (browser method web.tests.browser.test_browser_bundled_scene_assets.BundledSceneAssetsBrowserTest.test_terminal_pack_static_decode): the full-bleed composition holds and the illustration stays distinguishable from its sibling at that viewport.
visual_review.contact_sheet: Reviewed as a two-up contact sheet beside city_street: scene identity, palette and composition are distinct for both terminal members.
